text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I know there are chilled
delivery services that keep stuff cold,
but are there
delivery services that keep
things hot too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono steps into my office and

immediately throws me for a loop with
her bizarre
question.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... So actually, I got this letter in
the mail...
choice_data_list: I don't think so, but... why?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And it said, "I love watching you race,
Miss Bono!
You're big and powerful like
a truck!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Reading that made me so happy! I was
going to write back, but the sender's
mom added a note saying not to worry
about replying, since I'm probably so
busy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So instead of a letter, I thought I could
send them
a pot of Nankai chanko! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Well, I guess I can't anyway
if there
aren't any heated delivery
services around.
choice_data_list: Won't it cause trouble if they sen...
Are you sure it won't be a problem...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I know! I can just use a chilled
delivery
service to send them a tub of
homemade ice
cream!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'd better start making it now! ♪ I'm just
going to
head out to the neighborhood
supermarket real
qui—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hastily stop Hishi Akebono before she
runs off. She might have a big appetite,
but it looks like
that fan letter has filled
her right up with happiness.
choice_data_list: Let's just give a normal reply!
Let's stick to a normal reply!
